_about: SERIES SHELF of the Sacred Books of the East (Clarendon Press, Oxford, 1879-1910, ed. F. Max Müller), the Victorian scholars' fifty-volume library of Asian scripture in English. Lane C already holds Müller's Upanishads and Dhammapada (muller), Palmer's Qur'an (palmer) and Legge's Chinese volumes (legge); this shelf takes the rest. Round 62 holds the Buddhist and Jain volumes: Rhys Davids's Buddhist Suttas (1881) and Questions of King Milinda (1890-94), Rhys Davids and Oldenberg's Vinaya Texts (3 vols, 1881-85), Beal's Fo-sho-hing-tsan-king (1883), Kern's Lotus Sutra (1884), Jacobi's Jaina Sutras (1884, 1895) and Buddhist Mahayana Texts (Cowell, Müller, Takakusu, 1894). Original Clarendon printings only: Motilal Banarsidass reprints of the same volumes (1960s on) were spotted by their front matter and refused. Each title gates on its own translator. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 62); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_excluded.motilal-reprints: Motilal Banarsidass reprints (Delhi, 1960s on) of the same volumes, e.g. in.ernet.dli.2015.224726 (vol. 11), 224728 (vol. 13) and 226564 (vol. 49), whose front matter says 'First published by the Oxford University Press ... Reprinted by Motilal Banarsidass': post-1930 printings, refused in favour of the Clarendon originals.
_excluded.held-elsewhere: Vols 1 and 15 (Müller's Upanishads) and vol. 10's Dhammapada are on muller; vols 6 and 9 (Palmer's Qur'an) on palmer; vols 3, 16, 27, 28, 39 and 40 (Legge) belong to the legge shelf.
